craft_notes: Sthāyin: ānanda as forgotten-treasure-found; bhakti as prāpti (finding); vyabhicāri harṣa of burden-lowering. Sanskrit-first: na…na…na (triple refusal — wealth/women/splendour, then pictured-light refused too); bhāraharaṇam iva (LIKE burden-lowering — iva simile kept as simile); smṛti (FOUND-treasure — the forgotten remembered). Rows: 9 (refusal catalogue — each pleasure named then refused; naming IS the finding), 10 (burden image left standing, no gloss), 1 (light-rise AFFIRMED last — the refused word returns; ring closes whether same-or-different, held open). Close: ‘the light-rise’. Rupture: ‘Joy —’ (refusals turn to naming — the dash after Joy holds the turn). Rejected: gilding — killed: bluntness is the music; ‘treasure-trove’ — killed: domesticates the finding; deciding same-vs-different light — killed: held open (the ring's ambiguity IS the verse). Read aloud: BLISS-here is NOT wealth-MIDD-le … NOR lamp-SUN-moon-MADE … JOY — DIFF-er-ence GA-thered, FREED in BLISS-ground, LIKE the LOW-er-ing OF a BUR-den — IS the for-GOTT-en TREA-sure FOUND.

lines: Bliss here is not wealth-middle-intoxication, nor like enjoying women,
nor lamp-sun-moon-made splendour-multitudes — nor even the light-rise.
Joy — difference gathered, freed in bliss-ground, like the lowering of a burden —
is the forgotten treasure found of the all-nonduality state: the light-rise.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ānandaḥ atra na vittamadhya madavan naivāṅganāsaṅgavat dīpārkendukṛta prabhāprakaravan naiva | prakāśodayaḥ harṣaḥ saṃbhṛtabhedamuktisukhabhūr bhārāvatāropamaḥ sarvādvaitapadasya vismṛtanidheḥ prāptiḥ prakāśodayaḥ
notes: saMbhRta-compound kept whole (one-vs-several open); prakASodaya same-vs-different open (refused first, affirmed last — ring works either way) — BOUNDARY

reads_against.argmap: What is bliss, and how is it found? → Bliss is neither pleasure nor splendour but joy like burden-lowering — the attainment of the forgotten treasure.
c1_essence: Bliss is neither wealth-intoxication nor lamp-sun-moon splendour. Joy with gathered-difference-liberation-bliss-ground, like burden-lowering, is the attainment of the forgotten treasure of the all-nonduality state — the light-rise. Bliss = prakāśodaya: difference gathered, burden set down, treasure remembered.
